posts.title: AWS Emulator Passes 75% of Its Own Tests. Here Is How to Read the Other 25%
posts.description: The release file for AWS Emulator v1.0.544 scores 46,026 units: 75.4% pass overall, 56.3% on wire-level workflows, 95.5% on the calls a serverless app actually makes. A ledger of which green tests are evidence.

posts.title: One Line in site-packages: The Python Startup Hook Nobody Audits
posts.description: Two hijacked agent-framework wheels ran a credential stealer at every interpreter start without anyone importing the package. The mechanism is one import line in a .pth file. I measured which interpreter flags stop it (-I does not), what it costs, and how many .pth files on this host already execute code.

posts.title: The Dead TODO Tax: What Google Measured, and What Its Instrument Misses
posts.description: Google found stale TODO comments cost agents 77% more tokens in affected sessions. Fleet-wide that is 0.5%. A 14-repo census: just 2.7% name a ticket.
